BiblicalUsage: Hathath is the son of Othniel and grandson of Kenaz, named in the genealogy of Judah. His name means fearful, the same spelling as the word for dismay, but here it belongs to a man, not a feeling.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God puts even a fearful name in the record of His people without shame. Hathath stands among the sons of Othniel, and his name is kept with theirs.
